tailscale_ssh.notes: tailscaled intercepts SSH connections to port 22 on the Tailscale IP. With action: 'accept' it TERMINATES the connection and authorises on tailnet device identity — it does NOT pass through to sshd, and authorized_keys is never consulted on this path. Two consequences: (1) sshd directives do not govern it, which is why PermitRootLogin no did not stop root until root was removed from acl_users (#932); (2) tailnet membership alone grants a shell as any account listed in acl_users, with no key and no password (#931). The LAN path (192.168.1.158, 192.168.1.97) is unaffected and still enforces authorized_keys. ACL changes are logged in ADR-0004.
